title: Daq manifesto
description: A pinned statement 250% of the window tall: a bold monospace label with a rule, a row of keyword tags at the right, and a huge uppercase paragraph in thin type with a few heavy key words. While it is pinned the key words fill in from hollow outlines one after another and their tags light up; as it leaves, the whole block dims to 15% and lifts 40px.
notes: transparent: made to sit over daq-backdrop; pass a background in className without it
all motion is CSS scroll-driven (no JavaScript); without support the key words show filled
the tags show from 1024px; on phones the label's rule runs to the edge
